Transparency should go beyond statements. It should be something users can independently verify.

Binance has completed coverage of assets impacted in the recent security incident and published a new Proof of Reserves snapshot.

With zero-knowledge proof generation, users can verify that their assets are backed at a minimum of 1:1.

👉 https://t.co/wQzBvVdFWd

Binance has completed coverage of assets impacted in the security incident and we have published a new Proof of Reserves snapshot. Once the zero-knowledge proof is generated, users can independently verify that their assets are backed at a minimum of 1:1 - https://t.co/2cKzTtWddW.

To our users and community: thank you for your patience and understanding.
